name: exiting-company
description: Prepare a SaaS company for acquisition or exit — valuation drivers by buyer type (strategic, PE, bootstrap), due diligence readiness, EBITDA vs ARR multiples, and 12–24 month exit timeline. Use when planning an exit, preparing for acquisition, or maximizing company value for a future sale. Triggers on: "exit strategy", "sell company", "acquisition prep", "M&A", "due diligence", "company valuation", "exit planning", "PE acquisition", "bootstrap exit".
